title.value: The effect of task and training on intermediate representations in convolutional neural networks revealed with modified RV similarity analysis
title.justification: The title clearly describes the study focus of using modified RV similarity analysis to understand intermediate representations in CNNs and the effect of task and training on them.
title.quote: The effect of task and training on intermediate representations in convolutional neural networks revealed with modified RV similarity analysis

analysis.description: The paper explores the use of the modified RV coefficient (RV2) as a similarity metric to compare the representations within convolutional neural networks (CNNs) trained under different conditions (standard training, freeze training, random layers, untrained network). The study aims to validate RV2's efficacy in uncovering interpretable patterns in neural representations and understanding the effects of various training methods on these patterns.

type.justification: The paper involves experimentation with different convolutional neural network architectures and training regimes, comparing their intermediate representations using the RV2 coefficient.
type.quote: Here we explore the use of RV2 to characterize intermediate representations of simple convolutional neural networks.
